item.description:
0.9.0

Command suggestions now work over SSH, not just serial.

  • Suggestions over SSH. What you typed on that host, completed in grey; press → to accept. On by default, and off per host with File ▸ Suggest Commands Here.
  • It gives up when it stops being sure — after ↑, Tab or ⌃R, inside vim or less, and while a password is being typed. Nothing is sent unless you press →.
  • Passwords are never remembered, and the value after words like password or community is cut off even when the device echoed it.
  • The grey text targets a contrast ratio instead of a fixed transparency, so it reads the same on any theme.
